note: Standing calendar, edited rarely: public holidays and observances (c = nl, be, de, us, jfc = JFCBS HQ closed, nat = an allied nation's staff off with the HQ open, clinic = Geilenkirchen clinic closures, info). Rows may carry `shops` (store closures). `hqFrom` is the first date the HQ day-off list covers., school breaks per system, and seasonal markets. The morning run completes missing school years when they are published and otherwise leaves this file alone. Window: 2026-11-01 to 2028-04-30. Holiday dates are computed from the statutory rules (Easter-based dates via the Gregorian algorithm) and should be spot-checked once a year.
